steps.player: Whistles*

steps.npc: OY!! You're going to have to do better than that! Sheesh, what an amateur.

steps.player: Is there much competition between you raccoons and the magpies?

steps.npc: Magpies have nothing on us! They're just interested in shinies.
Us raccoons have a finer taste, we can see the value in anything, whether it shines or not.

steps.player: Hey Rocky, do you want to commit a bank robbery with me?

steps.npc: If that is the level you are at, I do not wish to participate in criminal acts with you [player name].

steps.player: Well what are you interested in stealing?

steps.npc: The heart of a lovely raccoon called Rodney.

steps.player: I cannot really help you there I'm afraid.
Hi Rocky, how are you?

steps.npc: Your shoe laces are untied!
The master thief strikes again! Here you go, have it back.

steps.player: I better keep my eyes on you...

standard-dialogue-overhead-dialogue-inte.npc: Watch out! Rocky coming at ya!

steps.player: Hey Ziggy, do you have any relation to a raccoon named Rocky?

steps.npc: Who me? No, me and Rocky are not related.

steps.player: Really? But you look so similar.

steps.npc: That's because a Tanuki is a master of disguise! I could pretend to be a human if I wanted to.

steps.player: Wow! Why don't you do it now then?

steps.npc: I said if I wanted to, I don't want to.

steps.player: Hey Ziggy, *giggles* do you happen to know any good plumbers?

steps.npc: Well that's a bit of a silly question isn't it.

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.npc: Why would I, a Tanuki, know any good plumbers?

steps.player: I don't know, you might have come across one before.

steps.npc: Well, clearly not, since I spend most of my time following you around.

steps.player: Ziggy! I've got a treat for you!

steps.npc: Really! Where! Let me have it!
Why are you hiding it? Let me have it! Please, please, please!
Oh, where did the treat go? Did you drop it?

steps.player: Yeah, I must have dropped it, sorry about that Ziggy.
Have you ever seen a blue panda before?

steps.npc: Blue Panda? That's ridiculous, there's only one type of panda and it is a beautiful red.

steps.player: Hey Red, hows it going?

steps.npc: Hi! Want to see me do a really fast cartwheel?

steps.player: Uh, yeah, sure go ahead.

steps.npc: Want to see me do it again?

steps.player: Huh? Nothing happened...

steps.npc: To your eyes...

steps.player: Do you know a raccoon called Dufresne?

steps.npc: No, I don't believe I have.
